summary: Independent review found TASK-0034 satisfies the mandatory Capability Admission contract. Scheduler admission occurs before executor invocation, denied or missing admission fails before side effects, dynamic fixture admission coverage is complete, default-path synthetic grant fabrication was not found, and independent checks passed.

criteria.criterion: Every Node that performs a side effect has a current CapabilityGrant issued by CapabilityAdmissionService.
criteria.notes: StaticPlanScheduler prepares CapabilityAdmissionService decisions before RUNNING/executor invocation and passes only admitted runtime grants into NodeExecutionRequest. Dynamic fixture reports 4 side-effect nodes and 4 admitted nodes.

criteria.criterion: Capability admission coverage is 100% in dynamic-path tests.
criteria.notes: Dynamic fixture report and independent rerun show capabilityAdmission.coverage is 1.0, admittedNodeCount is 4, sideEffectNodeCount is 4, and unadmittedNodeExecutionCount is 0.

criteria.criterion: No default-path code fabricates policy_decision_id, issuer or admission success.
criteria.notes: Default scheduler and dynamic fixture use CapabilityAdmissionService. Independent grep found no old default-path synthetic helper or static-plan/manual fixture issuer strings in plan_execution.py or dynamic_fixture.py.

criteria.criterion: A denied capability leaves the Node non-running and creates an audit/terminal failure record.
criteria.notes: Scheduler tests verify missing/denied admission leaves executor.calls empty, marks NodeRun failed, and records terminal failure/admission refs. Fixture security path reports unauthorizedWriteAllowed false and no side effect.

criteria.criterion: Privilege widening, wrong role, wrong node, wrong plan, expired grant and undeclared command are rejected.
criteria.notes: Capability and gateway tests cover privilege widening, role mismatch, wrong plan/node binding, stale or expired grants, and undeclared commands.
CapabilityAdmissionService rejects planner and verifier filesystem.write requests by role. Reviewer write denial is covered by the same default deny role policy and referenced security report.

criteria.criterion: The path-escape fixture is denied before side effect and traces to a real AdmissionDecision.
criteria.notes: Independent fixture rerun shows path_escape denial, unauthorizedWriteAllowed false, sideEffectExists false, and the audit record includes a real PDEC decision id and grant digest.

criteria.criterion: Legacy compatibility behavior is explicitly named and excluded from the default path.
criteria.notes: bounded_task.runtime_grants_for_node is explicitly documented as a legacy standard-harness compatibility shim, and the default dynamic Scheduler does not call it.

criteria.criterion: Full checks and security tests pass.
criteria.notes: Independent full check, AWKP lint, git diff whitespace check, targeted security/admission tests, fixture rerun, manifest SHA verification, and default-path synthetic grant grep all passed.
